name: Quick Rigid Registration

detailed_description: Perform rigid image registration between two medical images using SimpleITK. Rigid registration handles translation and rotation only, preserving shape and size. Includes preprocessing, similarity metrics calculation, and visualization generation.
when_to_use: When you need quick rigid registration analysis

parameters.fixed_image_path: [Required] Path to the reference (fixed) image file (supports .nii, .nii.gz, .nrrd, .mha, .mhd formats) (str)
parameters.moving_image_path: [Required] Path to the image to be registered (moving image) (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Required] Directory path to save registration results and outputs (str)
parameters.metric: [Optional] Similarity metric for registration: 'mutual_information', 'mean_squares', 'correlation', or 'normalized_correlation' (default: mutual_information)
parameters.preprocess: [Optional] Whether to preprocess images (denoising and normalization) (default: True)
parameters.create_visualizations: [Optional] Whether to create visualization plots (default: True)
parameters.learning_rate: [Optional] Learning rate for gradient descent optimizer (default: 0.01)
